blocks.note: Identify regular synthetic forms from their conjugation, stem, and endings, then supply the contextually licensed tense or mood; the hygiene gate removes the synthetic matching rows and both judgment-dependent alternatives.
Retrieve high-frequency irregular forms in both directions across the present, imperative, passato remoto, future, conditional, gerund, and participle.

Derive prefixed and suffixed irregular verbs from a known family model, while treating compiere and the variable -fare family as mixed systems; the hygiene gate removes the three printed alternative rows.
Produce special and formal imperative forms, including clitic attachment; the synthetic table and route passage plus all judgment-dependent alternatives are excluded.
Choose finite agreement from grammatical number and the person hierarchy of coordinated subjects rather than from an English collective reading.

Build compound forms and select avere or essere for transitive, reflexive, controlled-activity, change-of-state, and bounded-motion readings. The post-gate cap retains all clean a-c items plus d1-d3 and stops before the source's unflagged d4/d5 prompt-boundary merge.
Apply participle agreement with essere, third-person direct-object clitics, partitive ne, and reflexive structures while leaving ordinary avere forms invariant.
Build fare plus an unmodified active infinitive, placing the infinitive's performer with a or da according to active or passive focus and attaching clitics to fare.

Transform direct objects into passive subjects and choose essere, venire, andare, or si passivante for neutral, dynamic, obligatory, or impersonal-passive meanings; alternative translations and the synthetic recipe passage are excluded.
